name: Both-Shores Fractionally Representable Ample Classes Are Contained in Fractionally Representable Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Both-Shores Fractionally Representable Ample Classes belongs to Fractionally Representable Ample Classes.
proof: An ordinary allocation is a nonnegative integral full allocation. Applying this on the required original and complementary shores proves the inclusion.
